title.en: Workflow recovery: retry, refresh and reset are different
title.zh: 审核失败之后：重试、刷新与重置是三条路径

summary.en: Trace WF-104 through a failed request and a version conflict, with precise before/after states and eight existing model tests.
summary.zh: 沿 WF-104 追踪请求失败与版本冲突，用明确的前后状态和 8 项既有模型测试解释恢复路径。

basis.en: A source review of the public React + Ant Design learning demo. Eight reducer tests were rerun on 1 November 2026. Tasks and responses are synthetic; no backend or real multiuser concurrency is involved.
basis.zh: 基于公开 React + Ant Design 学习演示的源码复盘，2026-11-01 重跑 8 项 reducer 测试。任务与响应均为合成，不连接后端，也未执行真实多人并发。

paragraphs.en: After reset, WF-104 is in review at version 3. As reviewer, choose Network error and approve it. The expected result is review/version 3 with a retry action; an error must not be presented as approval.
paragraphs.zh: 重置后，WF-104 处于审核中，版本为 3。使用审核人角色，选择“网络错误”后点击“通过”。预期仍为审核中／版本 3，并提供重试；失败不能被界面包装成审核成功。

paragraphs.en: Switch the next response to Success before retrying. The task moves to approved/version 4. The next-response selector is deliberately persistent; retrying with Network error still selected should fail again.
paragraphs.zh: 重试前把“下次响应”改回“正常响应”。任务进入已通过／版本 4。模拟结果选择会保留；仍选“网络错误”时再次重试，应该继续失败。

title.en: 02 / A conflict requires a new decision
title.zh: 02 / 冲突之后，需要重新确认

paragraphs.en: Reset, select Version conflict, then approve WF-104. The client keeps version 3 and records a simulated remote version 4. Further submissions are blocked. Refresh updates the snapshot to 4 but does not approve the task.
paragraphs.zh: 重置后选择“版本冲突”，再通过 WF-104。客户端保持版本 3，记录模拟远端版本 4，并阻止继续提交。点击“刷新快照”后版本更新为 4，但任务不会自动通过。

paragraphs.en: Select Success and approve again: the task becomes approved/version 5. Refresh and approval are separate because the original decision may no longer be appropriate for the newer record. A real API must atomically verify and update the version.
paragraphs.zh: 选择“正常响应”并重新通过后，任务才成为已通过／版本 5。刷新和审核分开，是因为原决定可能已不适用于新记录。真实 API 还必须在同一原子操作内检查并更新版本。

paragraphs.en: Start an action and immediately reset. The UI clears its timer and advances a token; the reducer ignores callbacks without a matching pending operation. This protects local state, but it is not a general server rollback mechanism.
paragraphs.zh: 开始操作后立即重置。界面清除定时器并递增 token；reducer 忽略没有匹配 pending 操作的回调。它保护的是本地状态，不是通用的服务端回滚机制。

paragraphs.en: Only one operation may be pending in this demo. That keeps recovery legible, at the cost of blocking edits to different tasks. Per-task concurrency would require per-task pending state and independently scoped tokens.
paragraphs.zh: 本例同一时刻只允许一个 pending 操作，恢复路径因此较清楚，代价是不同任务也不能同时保存。若要逐任务并发，就需要按任务维护 pending 与独立令牌。

title.zh: 04 / 验证与仍需补齐的部分

paragraphs.en: All eight existing tests passed: successful transitions, roles, invalid versions, pending locks, retry, conflict recovery, late callbacks and immutable state. Browser focus is a separate concern: when a card moves, the interface returns focus to that card.
paragraphs.zh: 8 项既有测试全部通过，覆盖成功转换、角色、非法版本、请求锁、重试、冲突恢复、旧回调及状态不可变性。焦点属于另一层检查：卡片跨列后，界面把焦点送回该卡片。

paragraphs.en: The useful lesson is to define a recoverable next action for each failure. A future service integration still needs authorization, idempotency, transaction-level version checks and real multi-tab tests.
paragraphs.zh: 这次复盘的重点是为每类失败定义一个可恢复的下一步。接入真实服务后，仍要补齐授权、幂等、事务内版本检查及真实多标签页测试。
